comment: The poker-style equipment card's geometry (web balance.ui.equipmentCard at b8cfe4fac, content/config/ui/components/card.json sizing): the frame is laid out at this design size and scaled into whatever box holds it. Each region has a floor (minPx), a priority that breaks ties when the frame is too short (the lowest gives up its slack first) and a share (grow) of whatever is spare; a region with nothing to say takes no floor (the tags row of a relic). 'text' are the type scale's ceilings in design px; 'footer' says where the rarity and the owned count go. 'art' names the card's picture by template: an armament's icon ({art}: its inventoryArtKey or id), or for an armour set the painted outfit's menu pose ({key}: the wearer's art class, then '-' and its art key; a set shared by every class is {class}-{id}), the web's equipmentCardArt over armamentIconAsset and armourMenuAsset.
